scientific_integrity: Explicit ODE/Kirchhoff proof and separately executable symbolic and finite-element consistency checks; finite tests are not universal verification. No independence claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unit lengths, uniform arclength, real L2 and exactly two regular branching generations; only first two singular values and their multiplicities classified, not arbitrary rooted trees. General metric-tree spectral reductions and inverse spectral determinants are prior work; equivalent literature may exist.
title: Two singular values distinguish branching in equilateral two-tier metric trees
